reason: My guests ask about Wi-Fi, parking and check-out, and I already have a printed sheet and my phone. I am not paying €35 a month and €150 up front for something I do myself for free.
objection: It is a monthly fee for answering three questions I already know by heart, and on my income every euro counts. If something breaks I have to call my nephew anyway.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and a one-time price for the season, maybe €50 for the summer, and seeing a neighbour use it and saying it saved them real time with the German guests.
